name: local-merge
description: Local Merge proactive AI miniapp for conversation insights

scripts.dev:local: bun run backend:dev:local & bun run miniapp:dev; wait
scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run --project local-merge --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'MERGE_BACKEND_URL=${MENTRA_PUBLIC_MERGE_BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:3130}; MERGE_PORT=${LOCAL_MERGE_PORT:-3130}; MERGE_JWKS_URL=${MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL:-https://core.dev.us-west-2.mentraglass.com/.well-known/jwks.json}; MERGE_ISSUERS=${MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS:-cloud-core,mentra}; MERGE_WEB_SEARCH=${MERGE_ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH:-true}; PORT=$MERGE_PORT MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL=$MERGE_JWKS_URL MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS=$MERGE_ISSUERS MERGE_ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=$MERGE_WEB_SEARCH MENTRA_PUBLIC_MERGE_BACKEND_URL=$MERGE_BACKEND_URL bun run backend:dev:local & MENTRA_PUBLIC_MERGE_BACKEND_URL=$MERGE_BACKEND_URL bun run miniapp:dev; wait'
scripts.backend:dev:doppler: doppler run --project local-merge --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL=${MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL:-https://core.dev.us-west-2.mentraglass.com/.well-known/jwks.json} MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS=${MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS:-cloud-core,mentra} MERGE_ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=${MERGE_ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH:-true} PORT=${LOCAL_MERGE_PORT:-3130} bun run backend:dev:local'
scripts.miniapp:pack: cd miniapp && PKG=$(node -p "require('./miniapp.json').packageName") && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./miniapp.json').version") && rm -f build/$PKG-$VERSION.zip && mkdir -p build && cd dist && zip -qr ../build/$PKG-$VERSION.zip .
scripts.pack: bun run miniapp:build && bun run miniapp:pack
